subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The mob **__broke up__** the norms of the country.
solution: The correct answer is **"violated."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Broke up"** in the given sentence means to disrupt or disturb. (विघ्न डालना या परेशान करना) • **Example**: *She **broke up**__ all the rules of the management.* • **"Violated"** means to break or disregard a rule or law. (किसी नियम या कानून को तोड़ना या उसकी अवहेलना करना) __ • **Example**: *She **violated**__ all the rules.* • Hence, the option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence is **"violated."** • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "invade"**, means to enter forcefully or aggressively. (जबरदस्ती या आक्रामक तरीके से प्रवेश करना) • **Option 3, "disturb"**, is similar in meaning to "broke up." (परेशान करना) • **Option 4, "damaged"**, refers to physical harm. (हानि) 30:T9aa, The correct answer is **"since."**
